named_mechanism: Observational reconciliation of multi-method glacier mass change estimates using GlaMBIE consensus products
definition: Use the GlaMBIE published consensus regional/global annual calendar-year series as the reconciled benchmark, and use hydrological-year per-method outputs plus raw input coverage to diagnose cross-method agreement and coverage.
assumptions: Published GlaMBIE result files faithfully represent the project's reconciliation pipeline.
Calendar-year consensus series are the correct basis for global 2000–2023 benchmarking.
Hydrological-year per-method columns are sufficient for method-agreement diagnostics even without rerunning the full combination algorithm.
non_negotiable_steps: Load all 19 regional calendar-year result files and the global file.
Restrict the benchmark window to intervals fully contained within 2000–2023.
Report both Gt and m w.e. with uncertainties.
Preserve regional granularity in at least one exported table and one figure.
Provide explicit method-coverage and method-versus-consensus diagnostics.

implementation_status.deviation_note: The original reconciliation algorithm is not reimplemented from raw inputs; instead, the published GlaMBIE consensus results are treated as the authoritative reconciled benchmark and are analyzed transparently.
